title: Affective AI Safety: The Missing Piece in LLM Safety
measurement_description: The paper is a conceptual piece proposing a taxonomy of affective AI safety harms. It does not conduct empirical evaluations or directly measure faith or religion. It only briefly mentions, by citing other works, that emotion recognition systems reproduce societal biases along religious lines.
findings: As a conceptual framework, the paper did not conduct original testing on religion. It briefly noted that prior research has documented systematic biases and stereotyping in emotion recognition systems along religious lines.
